title: Remove redundant TT miss guards in search
rationale: Stockfish PR #6835 removes redundant ttHit-dependent reassignments after TT probe. It passed a large non-regression STC and is explicitly non-functional. FayE's current TT probe safely initializes miss data, so the optimization was directly testable without changing NNUE features.

combined_confirmations.interpretation: The two independent 1200-game confirmations cancel almost exactly in aggregate. The hosted-runner NPS signal also weakened from +0.752% in confirmation 1 to 0.000% in confirmation 2.

decision_reason: Do not merge FAYE-0005. The first confirmation was positive but the independent repeat reversed direction; together the 2400 confirmation games are essentially neutral, and the efficiency signal was not reproducible on the repeat. Move to a different isolated mechanism.
notes: One mechanism only: remove redundant ttHit guards for move/value after probe in main search and qsearch.
No NNUE architecture, relational feature, or time-management changes.
Screen NPS +1.527%, confirmation-1 NPS +0.752%, repeat-confirmation NPS 0.000%.
